$comment: Declared coverage for every browser-proof driver under tools/test/fixtures/run-*.mjs, checked by tools/check-browser-proofs-discovered.mjs.
A driver absent from proofs fails the guard by name; a proof whose file is gone fails it as stale. Declaration is not execution.

required: a release qualification must verify an attributable receipt from one real execution at private/browser-proof-receipts/<driver stem>/<receipt>; a missing, failed or unattributable receipt is a failure, never a skip.
manual: hand-run by the named owner or document; reported as discovered and unexecuted, never counted as coverage.
platform-limited: runnable only on the named platform; reported as discovered and unexecuted on every host, never counted as coverage.
Census 2026-09-10 (B1-12/B1-13, T58): 43 drivers, 38 named by nothing that runs; the packaged-driver guard skips tools/test/ by construction.

research.reason: Research view browser journey: needs MC_PLAYWRIGHT_ROOT, a served origin in BENCHMARK_TEST_ORIGIN, an output directory in BENCHMARK_TEST_OUTPUT and lane fixtures; some variants also need pinned native engines. Documented in docs/research-benchmark-builder.md and executed by the Research lanes when their surface changes, never by the cut.

tree.reason: Focused headless interaction check run by hand from the repository root (docs/NATIVE-DEVELOPMENT.md): starts its own loopback Vite server, uses PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE and writes its own evidence directory. Hand-run when the corresponding surface changes; not a cut gate and not counted as executed coverage.

run-first-use-navigation.mjs.reason: Mounted first-use guidance and navigation with real styles: pointer access, guide-less route transitions, focus, side/top layouts, resizing and T1357 centered icon-only narrow Guide controls. Uses a caller-supplied loopback fixture origin, MC_PLAYWRIGHT_ROOT and BENCHMARK_TEST_OUTPUT; starts no server and visits no Research route. Portable Linux/Windows preparation; declaration is not execution or cut coverage.

run-ledger-reset-controls.mjs.reason: Hand-run after Ledger reset controls change using PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE. Starts its own loopback Vite server and isolated Chromium page with fictional service replies; checks all four warnings, focus, cancellation, stale errors, commit controls and narrow layout. Canonical persistence and purchase races are covered separately by engine tests. Declaration alone is not executed coverage.

run-buttons-carry-app-style.mjs.reason: Owner-reported unstyled controls (Browse saved conversation, Full view). The zero-specificity :where(button:not([class])) rule in src/styles.css is the fix, and only this painted check proves it: without a receipt from one real execution a regression that deleted the rule would turn no gate red. Declaration here is not execution; the receipt is.

run-page2-interactions-native.mjs.reason: Retained earlier native-flow evidence and selectors; predates the current shared tree tabs and header (docs/NATIVE-DEVELOPMENT.md). Kept for its recorded evidence, not run as current proof.

run-page2-layout.mjs.reason: Refuses any output directory outside a fixed Windows development-account Temp path and redirects the browser profile to that account (page2-layout-README.md). The driver itself carries no Linux route; the Linux family guidance lives in browser-proofs-README.md.

run-page2-native.mjs.reason: Retained earlier native-flow evidence and selectors; predates the current shared tree tabs and header (docs/NATIVE-DEVELOPMENT.md). Kept for its recorded evidence, not run as current proof.

run-page2-zoom-linux.mjs.reason: Takes a Linux Chromium binary path as its only argument and launches it with an isolated HOME/config/cache (page2-zoom-linux-README.md); its negative controls exit 1 by design. Hand-run on Linux; not counted as executed coverage.

run-tree-navigation.mjs.reason: Needs an already running development origin in TREE_DEV_ORIGIN instead of starting its own server; otherwise as the tree family. Hand-run; not counted as executed coverage.

run-home-circle-jelly-material.mjs.reason: Historical proof for T360, removed in the owner ledger on 2026-09-22 as stale. The current Home view uses home-circle-fluid-classic.js for Blob and a static Classic default; home-circle-fluid.js, whose jelly shapes and material this driver measures, is not selected by any supported saved style. Preserve this driver for investigation of the retired renderer; it cannot qualify the current renderer. Owner rejected the home-circle body on sight while every arithmetic assertion was green ("right now it looks super bad and nothing like the image"). This driver paints the body in a real browser and judges the PICTURE against tools/test/home-circle-jelly-thresholds.mjs: transmission under two grounds, chroma and hue across the thickness, core luminance, razor silhouette and halo, luminance rising to the rim, one wet catch, one joined body. Needs a Vite origin serving this tree in HOME_CIRCLE_ORIGIN and a browser with real WebGL (msedge/chrome channels are tried, then chromium). Declaration is not execution; the receipt is, and its subject sha256 names the shader it judged.

run-home-circle-jelly-motion.mjs.reason: Historical proof for T365, removed in the owner ledger on 2026-09-22 as stale. The current Home view uses home-circle-fluid-classic.js for Blob and a static Classic default; home-circle-fluid.js, whose jelly shapes and material this driver measures, is not selected by any supported saved style. Preserve this driver for investigation of the retired renderer; it cannot qualify the current renderer. Owner: "bouncy and squishy and changes its state like liquid, mist, solid ... through the animations". This driver samples the body every drawn frame and judges the MOTION against tools/test/home-circle-jelly-thresholds.mjs MOTION: fixed-step seeded determinism, overshoot crossing rest twice, an intermediate frame that is not a linear blend of its endpoints, axes in opposition with area held, three states separating on two independent measures, interior lag 40-80 ms, transitions 350-600 ms, plus the motion strip. Same origin and browser needs as the material proof. Declaration is not execution; the receipt is.

run-home-circle-jelly-presence.mjs.reason: Historical proof for T360, removed in the owner ledger on 2026-09-22 as stale. The current Home view uses home-circle-fluid-classic.js for Blob and a static Classic default; home-circle-fluid.js, whose jelly shapes and material this driver measures, is not selected by any supported saved style. Preserve this driver for investigation of the retired renderer; it cannot qualify the current renderer. Precondition for every other home-circle proof: in each real agent state (idle, waiting, reading, thinking, writing, running) the renderer is stepping and a body is drawn on every theme, and the drawn-frame interval holds the ladder budget (owner: "keep lag in mind"; this is the pre-3D baseline). Names dead-bundle / software-WebGL / dead-shader refusals instead of scoring a blank. Same origin and browser needs as the material proof. Declaration is not execution; the receipt is.
